title: fix(service-automation): harden the OAuth2 connector connection door (ADR-0143 S1 should-fixes)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNx?thread=cmsg_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNx8EBNbLmv5dJG8pLoi3Moud)_

Fixes #28326

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:OAuth2 连接器"连接"流程的七处加固:等待回调的授权数据加密存放、连接记录按版本号条件写、读不了存储时回 503、令牌端点的重定向一律拒绝、明文 http 不再放行 `*.localhost`、断开连接不向厂商撤销令牌这一缺口写进路由台账和文档。
- 为什么改:这是 PR #28317(ADR-0143 S1)合同复核留下的七条 should-fix,连接入口已在 main 上,所有接 OAuth2 连接器的组织都会走到。
- 风险与回滚:升级那一刻正在进行中的连接会被当作过期,管理员重新点一次"连接"即可;回滚就是 revert 本 PR,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`oauth2-grant/authorization.ts`(封存方案与 KV 信任边界)、`connector-connections.ts`(`updateAtRevision` 条件写)、`oauth2-grant/token-endpoint.ts`(`redirect: 'manual'`)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/connector-connections.test.ts src/oauth2-grant`,预期 5 个文件全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

All seven items on the card, each measured on `main` at `3ba52069` first; all seven still stood.

| Item | On main | Now |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| SF2 pending authorization at rest | the verifier, user, organization and redirect URI sat in the cluster KV (or memory) as a plain object for 600 s | an AES-256-GCM envelope under a key derived (HKDF-SHA-256) from the raw `state`, which the server keeps only as a digest; the envelope's AAD names its KV slot |
| SF3 revision invariant | `recordRefresh` / `markReconnectRequired` read the row, compared the revision, then updated by id | one conditional write, `update(fields, { where: { id, revision }, multi: true })`, judged on the affected-row count; `connect()`'s reconnect uses the same write and refuses `503` when it loses the race |
| SF6 vendor revocation | `DELETE …/connection` deletes locally; the docs already said so, the route ledger row did not | the ledger row states the gap; docs say why (no revocation endpoint is known until ADR-0143 S2 discovery) and to revoke at the vendor after a leak |
| `readOrRefuse` | `connect()` and `revoke()` did a bare `read()`, so a throwing store answered an undeclared 500 | both route through `readOrRefuse` (503 `ConnectorCredentialUnavailableError`, the engine's message not carried) |
| token endpoint redirect | default `fetch` redirect mode follows a 307/308 with the form body (client secret, refresh token) | `redirect: 'manual'`, and any 3xx is refused as `OAuth2TokenResponseError` (503, configuration) |
| `*.localhost` | accepted as loopback for plain `http:` | refused; loopback is `localhost`, `127.0.0.0/8`, `[::1]` only |
| changeset bullet | not in the S1 note | in this card's `28326-oauth2-connection-door-hardening.md`; the merged `26702` note is untouched |

### Route changes from the dispatch, said plainly

- **SF2 is sealed with a state-derived key, not the host `ICryptoProvider`.** The provider's `CryptoContext.scope` is the closed `CRYPTO_CONTEXT_SCOPES` set (ADR-0128 D1), which has no member for this producer; adding one is a `packages/spec` change, outside this claim, and borrowing an existing member is what ADR-0128 forbids. Its handle is also persisted as a `sys_secret` row, a durable record for a ten-minute value. The state-derived key needs no shared secret, so it holds on a cluster whose replicas share only the KV. The trust boundary this leaves is written in the module header and the docs: a KV reader learns nothing; a KV writer cannot alter or move an entry it did not seal, but can still delete one or plant one under a state it chose itself. Cluster KV write access stays inside the platform's trust boundary, as it is for the cluster lock.
- **`redirect: 'manual'` plus an explicit refusal, not `redirect: 'error'`.** With `'error'` a redirect surfaces as a thrown `TypeError`, which this module reads as "no answer", that is `CONNECTOR_UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE`, retried on the backoff forever. A redirect is a wrong `tokenUrl`, so it is refused once as a configuration fault. Either way nothing is sent past the first hop.
- **No RFC 7009 call is added.** Nothing in the tree can supply a `revocation_endpoint` today, so a revoke call would be code no path reaches.

### Surface beyond the claim's file list

The claim names `connector-connections.ts`, `oauth2-grant/**`, `route-ledger.ts`, `connectors.mdx` and the changeset. Also touched, each forced by the change:

- `service-automation/src/connector-connections.test.ts` (new): the store's tests, over a real ObjectQL engine on SQLite.
- `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`: the two new engine doubles open with `assertEngineUpdateDispatch` / `assertEngineDeleteDispatch`, and `check:engine-double-contract --write` recorded them.
- `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx` and `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md`: the store has two fewer write call sites, so `tenant-audit-census.mjs --write` re-measured the generated block, and the hand-written prose counts were moved to match (257 to 255, 63 to 62 and 61, 179 to 177, 147 to 145).

## Why

ADR-0143 S1 put the OAuth2 connection door on `main` (PR #28317). Its contract review (record 6539266538) and delta review left these as should-fixes, and the card carries all of them.

## Tests

- `src/oauth2-grant/authorization.test.ts`: the KV holds no verifier, user, organization, instance, redirect URI or state, only `{ v, iv, ct, tag }`; an edited envelope, an envelope moved to another state's slot, and a plain value planted in the KV all open as nothing; the memory store round-trips the same envelope.
- `src/connector-connections.test.ts` (new, real engine): a refresh, a non-rotating refresh, the reconnect-required mark and a reconnect each write when the row has not moved; a reconnect landing between the refresh (or the refusal, or another reconnect) and its write is never overwritten; a revoked row is not written; `connect` and `revoke` over a store whose read throws answer 503 without the engine's message.
- `src/oauth2-grant/token-endpoint.test.ts`: a 307, 308 and 302 from a real local server are refused, and the `Location` server receives nothing.
- `src/oauth2-grant/endpoint-transport.test.ts`: `http://idp.localhost`, `http://localhost.localhost`, `http://localhost@evil.com` and `http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]` are refused. The last two were already refused on `main` (the WHATWG parser's host); they are pinned so the rule cannot regress.

## Acceptance notes

- A connect begun before this deploys and completed after it is refused as expired; the administrator begins it again. Stated in the changeset.
- The ablation ledger is below; every negative pin went red under the behaviour it bans and green again on restore.

## Verification

<details><summary>Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restore proven blob == HEAD)</summary>

The subjects are imported by relative path from `src/`, so no `dist/` build sits between mutation and test.

| Mutation (banned behaviour restored) | Red pins |
| :--- | :--- |
| `put` stores the plain pending object | 4: digest-key test, no-plaintext, edited envelope, moved envelope |
| `openPendingAuthorization` accepts a non-envelope as the value | 2: plain value planted, scheme version |
| `updateAtRevision` reverts to main's read, compare, update-by-id | 3: the three interleave pins (refresh, reconnect-required, reconnect); the seven preservation pins stay green |
| `revoke()` bare `read()` | 1: revoke 503 |
| `connect()` bare `read()` | 1: connect 503 |
| `redirect: 'manual'` removed | 3: 307, 308, 302 |
| `*.localhost` arm restored | 2: `idp.localhost`, `localhost.localhost` |

A first redirect ablation passed an empty replacement; the tool refused it on its own replacement-count check and restored the file before the tests ran, so nothing was read from it. It was re-run with a marker replacement, as above. A first SF3 ablation that dropped `revision` from the `where` also turned the by-id route back on and reddened every write test, so it isolated nothing; the read-compare-update form above is the one that reproduces main.

</details>

<details><summary>Local runs (head f9577543)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation typecheck` and `test`: 243 files, 3084 tests passed (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- After the last test edit: typecheck plus `connector-connections`, `oauth2-grant/*`, `connector-connection-door`, `connector-materialization`: 7 files, 157 tests passed.
- `packages/runtime`: `domains/automation-connector-connection-door.test.ts` 12 passed, `route-ledger.conformance.test.ts` 8 passed, `pnpm typecheck` exit 0.
- `pnpm lint` exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 101 derived families, all run, every one exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 101 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (`pnpm lint` recorded beyond the derivation). The first pass on `d06a0250` caught `check:engine-double-contract` and `check-tenant-audit-census` (and its self-test) red; both fixed in `f9577543`. Three families needed a full build (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, spec `check:skill-examples`, teardown-shape `--self-test` after unshallowing) and passed after it.

</details>
